endeavour-01: Cutscene from the current build: Iris, a red-haired character, in a gold-trimmed casino lounge with green patterned walls and red seats. The subtitle reads: "Three weeks under cover on Thessaly Station, and my reward is a floating casino."
endeavour-02: Gameplay frame: Iris, with red braided hair and a blue lace dress, raises both hands to her head beside a green card table in the casino. The subtitle reads: "Right. Mobility over modesty."
endeavour-03: Gameplay frame: a panelled boardroom with a long dark table, four seated characters in white jackets, a glowing figure with pink energy standing at the far end of the table, and a glass display case with a glowing object on the right.
endeavour-04: Gameplay frame: Iris seen from behind, walking down a dim corridor with a red carpet runner towards a "Private, Staff Only" door, with soft purple spore clouds drifting across the foreground.
endeavour-05: In-engine shot of the casino floor: a large hall with red patterned carpet, gold chandeliers, dark pillars with glowing light bands, card tables and red bar stools, with a few figures standing in T-poses.
endeavour-06: In-engine shot of a corridor with yellow-patterned wallpaper, framed pictures with a red disc, a red carpet runner and a bright yellow door on the right.
endeavour-07: In-engine shot of a laboratory-style room with glowing pink glass cylinders, purple wall cabinets, a wooden counter and an office chair.
endeavour-08: Blender render, not a game screenshot, of the Starlight Lounge set from above: a long bar with lit bottle shelves and a sign reading "Starlight Lounge, Cocktails and Viewing Gallery", red armchairs and sofas, round white tables, a gold chandelier, a compass-star emblem on the floor and potted palms.
